uncertainties: PIE cell (Piedmont+Liguria+west Lombardy; Milan city falls in it by Voronoi) assigned to the dominant power: Duchy of Milan 1410-92, France 1500 (Louis XII took Milan 1499 and Genoa). Savoy and mainland Genoa are folded in; Genoa entity kept alive via Corsica. Era11 hands PIE to Savoy after 1512.

LOM cell (seed near Verona) given to Venice from 1410 (Padua/Verona/Vicenza taken 1405-06), though era09 had Milan there in 1396; Venetian terraferma covers most of the cell after Brescia/Bergamo 1426-28.
VOL (Lviv) moved from Lithuania (era09's 1396) to Poland for all slices: Polish Galicia since 1349/1387 dominates the cell; Lithuanian Volhynia proper is its eastern fringe.
RUS_S (Chernigov-Severia) given to Lithuania 1410-92 reflecting Vytautas' expansion (era09 had the Golden Horde there in 1396), then to Muscovy at 1500 after the princely defections and Vedrosha.
Ireland switched from England (era09 1396) to Gaelic & Anglo-Irish lordships for the whole century: Gaelic resurgence reduced English rule to the Pale; noted on the England entity instead.

PRS cell (seed = Konigsberg) stays with the Teutonic Order after 1466 although Royal Prussia (Danzig, Marienburg) passed to Poland at the Second Thorn; the cession is carried in notes and Poland's population.

Kalmar Union modeled as one entity (id 'denmark') 1410-44; Sweden separate from 1453 (Karl Knutsson, then the Stures). King Hans' brief Swedish crown (1497-1501) is noted but Sweden kept separate at 1500 to match era11's 1512.

HRE kept as a single aggregate 1410-92, then split at 1500 into Austria, Bavaria, Saxony, Palatinate, Hesse, Wurttemberg, Lorraine and a Lower-Saxon rump to match era11's granularity at 1512; Matthias Corvinus' occupation of Vienna (1485-90) falls between slices and is carried in notes.

Provence held by an 'anjou_provence' entity 1410-80 (era09 lumped PRO with Angevin Naples in 1396, but Durazzo Naples and Anjou Provence were rivals after 1399). Rene died July 1480; the cell stays Angevin for the 1480 slice and is French from 1492 (annexed 1481).

Steppe partition is approximate: Great Horde keeps STE/DON/UKR_E after Crimea splits off (1441); Crimea gets STE from 1480 and UKR_E by 1500, DON passing to Crimea only after the Great Horde's destruction (1502, next era).
Granada's culture kept 'berber' to match era09's palette continuity although the Nasrids were an Arab dynasty.
Swiss population raised to 0.4-0.8m across the century (scholarly range), a deliberate step up from era09's 0.16 at 1396.
Marinid entity retained at 1466 as a collapsing placeholder: Abd al-Haqq was killed in 1465 and a sharif ruled Fez until the Wattasid takeover of 1472.

Eastern Anatolia: ARM_W treated as Aq Qoyunlu (Diyarbakir base) from 1453 while Qara Qoyunlu holds ARM/MES_N/MES_S until Chapakchur (1467); the whole east is Aq Qoyunlu 1480-1500 despite post-1490 fragmentation — Safavids arrive 1501 (era11).
Duchy of Athens kept at the 1453 slice (fell 1456-58); Byzantine Morea and Trebizond likewise shown at 1453 per brief, removed at 1466.
Cyprus: Lusignan through 1480 (Mamluk tributary from 1426, Venetian-controlled queen from 1474), Venetian from the 1492 slice (Cornaro cession March 1489).

NED given to Valois Burgundy from 1429 (Holland/Zeeland secured from Jacqueline of Hainaut 1428); era09 had it imperial in 1396. Burgundian Netherlands keeps id 'burgundy_valois' at 1480 under Mary+Maximilian, switching to 'habsburg_netherlands' (founded 1482) from 1492.
Silesia to Hungary only in the 1480 slice (Matthias held Moravia-Silesia 1469-90, confirmed at Olomouc 1479); back to the Bohemian crown 1492.
Used id 'knights_hospitaller' (as era11) rather than era09's 'hospitallers' — same polity on Rhodes.
Otranto: NAP stays Neapolitan at 1480 with a contested flag (Ottoman garrison held the city Aug 1480-Sept 1481).
